title: Preparation and evaluation of modified cyanobacteria-derived activated carbon for H 2 adsorption
material_description: ACK-2-7 | cyanobacteria-derived activated carbon; cyanobacteria (Dianchi, Yunnan; dried naturally 72 h, sieved to 30 mesh) carbonized at 400 C (ramp 20 C/min, 1 h dwell, tube furnace, N2 flushing) to give AC; KOH-activated (KOH/C mass ratio 2) at 700 C for 2 h

purification_method: washed with aq. HCl (1 mol/L) then deionized water to neutral pH; dried in vacuum oven at 105 C for 24 h
activation_method: KOH impregnation of AC (1 g AC in 50 mL KOH solution, KOH/C mass ratio 3; shaken 170 rpm, 25 C, 24 h; dried 105 C 24 h in vacuum oven), then activation at 800 C for 2 h (ramp 20 C/min) under N2 flow
source_location: main article p. 8 (journal p. 20419), Fig. 7a, series ACK-3-8 (blue filled up-triangles), digitized marker
notes: archive: fig7a_ACK-3-8_p1.json; y axis printed "Adsorbed H2 Volume (cm3/g)", STP not stated; read as cm3(STP)/g (consistent with Table 5 mg g-1 values); uptake_wt_pct = 0.0089938 x cm3(STP)/g (W1); isotherm_point_count 30 = markers counted on the plot (adsorption branch only); S_BET (N2 at -196 C, BET), V_total, V_micro and mean pore size D-bar from Tables 3 and 5; BET P/P0 range not stated; V_micro by t-plot (N2), V_total method not stated; D-bar method not stated (PSD by BJH, adsorption branch); temperature printed as -196 C (77.15 K); H2 measured on a static volumetric instrument (NOVA 3200e, Quantachrome), stated range 0.01-1 bar; uptake basis not named (excess by volumetric default); no degassing, sample mass, H2 purity or free-volume calibration stated for the H2 measurement
measuring_lab_id: Hu group, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
